fact: FAO's 2024 publication says the Gambian government's IFAD-supported ROOTS project developed a geospatial monitoring platform covering rice production, vegetable gardening, mangroves, forestry, agroforestry and infrastructure, with FAO generating project indicators starting from an updated land cover map under a new National Land Cover Reference System.

FAO says the Gambia GeoLab, a national geospatial platform on Google Earth Engine developed under the ROOTS project, translates satellite data into indicators for monitoring land cover, rice production, mangroves and forests.

Weather Impact states that a GCA-funded project built a Google Earth Engine web platform giving access to satellite data and agricultural indices, trained 12 Gambian government departments from April 2024, and aimed to transfer the services to the Department of Water Resources.
